about: OneGrasp Workplace Stress Check for working professionals (0-5, 5-15, 15+ years). Four areas - Workload, Toxic behaviour, Culture & psychological safety, Career & job security - in OneGrasp's own wording, one frequency scale and one time frame (the last 3 months), plus one closing coping question that is not scored into the areas. Item ids are stored in results - never reuse an id for a different question.

areas.title: Workload
areas.short: Tasks, deadlines, hours, control and clarity
areas.intro: How much work you carry, and how it is organised.

areas.title: Toxic behaviour
areas.intro: How people behave around you. A few questions are about difficult experiences - answer honestly; your answers are private to you.

areas.title: Culture & psychological safety
areas.short: Politics, bullying, speaking up, support, fit
areas.intro: How safe, fair and supportive your workplace feels.

areas.title: Career & job security
areas.short: Job security, growth, pay and recognition
areas.intro: How secure your job feels, and whether you are growing and fairly rewarded.

items.label: Too many tasks
items.text: I had more tasks than I could realistically finish.

items.label: Unrealistic deadlines
items.text: I was given deadlines that weren't realistic.

items.label: Working overtime
items.text: I worked late, on weekends or on holidays to keep up.

items.label: Work spilling into personal time
items.text: Work spilled into my personal time - calls, messages or tasks after hours.

items.label: Responsibilities outside the job
items.text: Responsibilities outside my job - family, home, studies - competed with work for my time and energy.

items.label: No freedom or flexibility
items.text: I had little freedom or flexibility over how, when or where I work.

items.label: Left out of decisions
items.text: Decisions that affected my work were made without asking me.

items.label: Unclear expectations
items.text: I wasn't sure what was expected of me.

items.label: Poor communication
items.text: Information I needed reached me late, unclearly or not at all.

items.label: Conflicting demands
items.text: Different people asked me for things that conflicted with each other.

items.label: Physical or mental exhaustion
items.text: I ended my working day physically or mentally exhausted.

items.label: Fear-based leadership
items.text: A leader or manager used anger, threats or fear to get work done.

items.label: Gaslighting
items.text: Someone made me doubt my own memory or judgement - denying what happened or twisting the facts.

items.label: Gossip and rumours
items.text: Gossip or rumours about people spread at work.

items.label: Cliques and exclusion
items.text: Cliques or in-groups left people out.

items.label: Undermining or credit stealing
items.text: Someone undermined my work or took credit for it.

items.label: Unfair or unethical treatment
items.text: I saw or experienced unfair or unethical treatment - for example because of gender, caste, religion, age or disability.

items.label: Harassment
items.text: I faced harassment - unwelcome, offensive or intimidating behaviour, including of a sexual nature.

items.label: Hostile team dynamics
items.text: People in my team blamed, put down or worked against one another.

items.label: Office politics
items.text: Office politics decided who got ahead.

items.label: Bullying or being belittled
items.text: I was bullied, belittled or humiliated at work.

items.label: Not safe to speak up
items.text: It felt unsafe to speak up, admit a mistake or disagree.

items.label: No support from colleagues
items.text: My colleagues didn't help or back me when I needed it.

items.label: Values don't fit the organisation
items.text: I felt my values didn't fit the way this organisation works.

items.label: Unsettling organisational change
items.text: Changes in the organisation - restructuring, new leaders, new systems - unsettled me.

items.label: Strained relationships
items.text: My relationships with people at work were a source of strain.

items.label: Fear of layoffs
items.text: I worried I could lose my job through layoffs, retrenchment or downsizing.

items.label: Risk of sudden job loss
items.text: I felt my job could end suddenly, with little or no warning.

items.label: No chance of promotion
items.text: I saw no real chance of promotion ahead of me.

items.label: No skill development
items.text: I had no chance to learn new skills or grow.

items.label: Salary below cost of living
items.text: My salary didn't comfortably cover my cost of living.

items.label: Pay doesn't match effort
items.text: My pay didn't reflect the effort I put in.

items.label: No recognition
items.text: My work and effort went unrecognised.

closing.text: Overall, how are you coping with work right now?
